_comment: Deal id → Dropbox listing folder, for the document publisher (publish-docs-from-dropbox) and the sync manifest read. This is a REPO-OWNED override that publish-from-dropbox never rewrites, so a deal's folder link survives every deals.json republish — unlike a `docFolder` field in deals.json, which Cowork must set and which gets wiped hourly. A deal's own deals.json `docFolder` still wins if present. Add a deal here (verified against Dropbox /_LEGACY/_Listings) to publish its Share-with-Seller / Share-with-Buyer / EX folders to the client portal.
